description: Fires when the opponent has three stones stacked on top of column 6 (the rightmost column) with the cell above empty, i.e. a vertical threat I must block in column 6; strongest right after they played the third stone there. Weakly fires for other must-blocks in column 6 created by their stone just played there (diagonal, horizontal). Same vertical threat in other columns, or a threat into an empty column 6 cell, does not fire.
effect: Pushes the move to column 6: forcing it high moves nearly all probability to column 6 (e.g. 0.00 -> 1.00 on positions where the model preferred col 1 or col 3); zeroing it barely changes play (col 6 1.00 -> 0.98), since other units also see the block.
notes: Minimal pairs: O vertical three in col 6 = 30-60, same in cols 0-5 = -1.2 to 1.0, my own col-6 vertical = 0.8, horizontal three into (0,6) = -11. Best dev F1 0.549 (P 0.86, R 0.40), AUROC 0.70, sim share 52.7 (p1). Broader rules (any col-6 threat cell, verticals in all columns) dropped precision to ~0.3. About 60% of firing is weak (act 1-5) and diffuse; I could not capture it simply. Synthesis best 73.0, below dev max 78.2.
